lede: Wednesday's HARC meeting is the one to watch this week: the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave goes before the commission for three separate Preliminary Large-Scale public hearings covering multiple new buildings in the Accommodations 2 zone — the kind of project that will shape that corner of town for a long time. The same day, the Board of County Commissioners takes up two Land Use Code amendments, including new rules for Natural Medicine Businesses and Nonconforming Lots. San Miguel County also holds its sixth working session on the housing code rewrite Thursday, pushing toward final recommendations on zoning, density, and workforce housing incentives.
